135295.synopsis:
Wei Yuexin landed a part-time job: forecasting natural disasters for people across different apocalyptic novel worlds.
Because of her videos, those living in apocalypse-ridden worlds received advance warnings of oncoming disasters. They made all kinds of preparations, even seizing the “golden fingers” meant for unscrupulous protagonists, bringing benefits to all of humanity. One by one, the destinies of these worlds were quietly rewritten.
「Acid Rain World」
Sky Screen: [The Acid Rain Apocalypse will begin soon. Tonight, many regions will experience acid rain.] 
People: Impossible! Who’s pulling this prank?
Government: Prepare immediately. The entire city goes into lockdown tonight. No one is allowed outside.
People: Has the government lost its mind?
After nightfall: Ahhh, it’s really raining acid! Thank goodness we prepared—we barely saved our lives!
「Rainstorm World」
Sky Screen: [This Rainstorm will last for a long time. Most parts of the world will be submerged.] 
People: Are you crazy? Where could all that water come from?
A few days later: Ahhh, why hasn’t the rain stopped? The Sky Screen was right! Is it too late to start building boats now?
associated_names: 为小说原住民预告天灾

135551.synopsis:
When she was six years old, Yin Zhuli witnessed her own father strangling her mother to death. For twelve years, she hid her hatred, unable to seek revenge because her father held immense military power and was a celebrated hero. Twelve years later, she lives with her aunt, inherits the family business, and becomes one of the wealthiest magnates in the world.
Meanwhile, the Da Ying Dynasty is in financial ruin due to years of continuous warfare. In order to raise military funds, the emperor sells the Ninth Prince, Shen Tingjiao—known as the most beautiful man in Chang’an but also notorious for his bullying and scandalous reputation—to Yin Zhuli and orders them to marry immediately.
After their marriage, Yin Zhuli dotes on the young Prince Shen. However, he gradually discovers that her true reason for marrying into the royal family is to avenge her mother’s death. The two strike a deal, and Yin Zhuli successfully betrays her father, the “God of War.” She then quickly betrays him again, causing him to die with the reputation of a traitor.
This entire revenge plot propels the young Prince Shen to the throne. Once he reaches the pinnacle of power, can he tolerate an overbearing and arrogant woman like Yin Zhuli? When power and love clash, will the king who rules the world choose his kingdom or his beauty?

158847.synopsis:
The Doomsday Survival Game has launched. Humanity’s home has been destroyed. Acid rain, dense fog, supernatural entities—once the journey begins, there’s no stopping. The scythe of death hangs over everyone’s head, and humanity is forced into a highway survival mode.
No one knows where the game came from. All we know is that, on that day, those who caught the game survived. These people—”Blue Star humans”—became “players” by binding to a vehicle. Those who failed to catch it? Extinct.
Supernatural creatures descend, and danger creeps closer. For players, their bound vehicles become their safe zones.
When the game began, Jiang Weiyang hit the jackpot—first pulling a limited-edition vehicle: a bus, then drawing an SSS-grade talent.
While others are worrying about affording a piece of bread, Jiang Weiyang is overwhelmed with fresh vegetables, fruits, and meat enhanced by buffs in her portable inventory.
While others are pinching pennies, she’s clearing out discounted items in game shops for free during side quests.
As she fights her way through dungeons and searches for her younger sister, Jiang Weiyang meets many companions and gradually climbs to the top of humanity’s power rankings—getting ever closer to the game’s core.
associated_names: 末路求生游戏，开局一辆大巴车

177535.synopsis:
Everything started when Gu Su bought a cheap, knockoff “Graveyard Mage” off Pinduoduo!
If he doesn’t want to die inside the game, he has to fight with everything he’s got—scavenging, battling, developing cities…
In the end, an existence on the level of an undead catastrophe rises within this world where game and reality have merged!
associated_names: 亡灵天灾从坟场魔开始
